title: Meet Vietnam
description: Travel to Vietnam with Spark and Mango: a country in Southeast Asia whose capital is Hanoi, where people speak Vietnamese and pay with the Vietnamese dong — plus two places we'd love to visit.

body.heading: Where in the world is Vietnam?
paragraphs: Vietnam is a country in Southeast Asia, which is part of Asia.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Vietnam is Hanoi.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: The language you will hear most in Vietnam is Vietnamese.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Vietnam is the Vietnamese dong.

body.heading: How big is Vietnam?
paragraphs: Vietnam covers about 331,000 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about half the size of Afghanistan.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: In Ha Long Bay — 'where the dragon descends' — nearly 2,000 limestone islands rise from green water. Families cruise overnight and kayak into caves and lagoons.
Hoi An is a riverside town of yellow merchant houses where hundreds of silk lanterns glow at night and boats carry floating candles down the river.

body.heading: Think and talk
paragraphs: 1. Find Vietnam on a map or globe. Which continent is it on — and can you name a country that sits next to it?
2. Spark and Mango can visit only ONE of the two places in this article. Which should they choose — and what would you pack for the trip?

takeaway: Vietnam in one breath: a country in Southeast Asia, capital Hanoi, where people speak Vietnamese and pay with the Vietnamese dong.
materials: A globe, atlas or world map (to find Vietnam)
Paper and crayons or pencils for the screen-free mission
supervision: Read this one together: a grown-up can help with tricky place names and hunt for Vietnam on the map as you read.
safetyNotes: Reading only — no physical activity is involved.
If your family ever visits the watery places in this article, water fun in Vietnam always needs a grown-up watching closely.
screenFreeExtension: Screen-free mission: find Vietnam on a map or globe, say its capital out loud, then draw the place you'd most love to visit there.
